# T3 Code

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: A dense coding-agent workspace: black page, quiet sidebar, centred composer, settings as a dialog.

Captured 2026-11-22, paired on the owner's tailnet, preview browser; Mac app window for the connected environments and project picker. Themes: dark, light.

A design reference for T3 Code, the hosted coding-agent app, version 0.1.8. Captured on 22 Nov 2026 from the owner's tailnet deployment at `kai-home-server`, paired in the preview browser. The app was in dark, then switched to light and restored to dark. Desktop width was 1440 by 900 CSS pixels, device pixel ratio 2. Phone width was not captured.

The product is a black or near-white workspace: a 256 px thread sidebar, a quiet top bar, a centred composer, and a floating details card. Settings is a dialog with a vertical section list, not a separate site. Colour roles are CSS custom properties on `html`. Neutrals in dark are white at a fixed alpha over black. The accent is indigo.

This package contains no T3 Code source. The screenshots show the owner's threads. Borrow structure and proportions, not the brand.

### Fonts (from README.md)

`--font-sans` is `-apple-system`, then `Inter Variable`. Inter Variable is declared in the stylesheet and was not loaded in the capture browser, so the painted text is the system sans. `--font-mono` is `ui-monospace`, then SF Mono and Menlo. Do not ship Inter as if it were measured on screen.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Hex values marked Derived are browser resolutions of `oklch()` and `color-mix()` tokens. The source token is named in each `$extensions.source.from`. Status colours in light were not re-sampled from a painted control. Focus-visible, pressed, and disabled rings were not held. The slash-command hover shot did not change the menu. Phone width (390) was not captured. Screenshots include the owner's thread titles and project paths. The Mac Add Environment dialog shows the product's own placeholders (`backend.example.com`, `PAIRCODE`, username `root`, port `22`). No pairing code was entered. General dropdowns were not opened.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Do keep the page black and raise only the composer, menus, and the details card.** The main column paints `--background: #000`. [screenshots/draft-new-thread-dark.png](screenshots/draft-new-thread-dark.png)
- **Do build dark neutrals from white at a fixed alpha.** Borders are white at 8%, hovers at 4%, inputs at 11%. [tokens.json](tokens.json)
- **Do give the composer the only large radius.** The shell is square. The composer and settings dialog use the larger radius steps. [screenshots/thread-conversation-dark.png](screenshots/thread-conversation-dark.png)
- **Do keep the accent for the one action that commits.** Model and send sit in the composer. Sidebar actions are icon buttons. [screenshots/draft-new-thread-dark.png](screenshots/draft-new-thread-dark.png)
- **Don't open settings as a page.** It is a dialog over the thread, with its own vertical list. [screenshots/settings-general-dark.png](screenshots/settings-general-dark.png)
